text.title: Die Schlachter-Bibel 1951
text.english: The Holy Bible in German, Schlachter 1951 version (translated by Franz Eugen Schlachter; revised 1951 by the Genfer Bibelgesellschaft)
text.changes: The verse wording is unchanged. The verse numbers of the German numbering that the source prints in brackets inside verses where it differs from the English numbering, e.g. “(03-2)”, are not shown (1,404 of them), nor Matthew 21:44, which the source leaves empty; the verses are laid out by Biblia. These changes are not endorsed by the original licensor.

files: The JSON files of this folder are the verses as Biblia reads them, under the licence of the text (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0).
